text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias raised it as a Tier 2 escalation in #central-team on 2 July 2025. It covers the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. That day the team confused Tansleigh Packaging with Tansley Parcel at first, but Tobias confirmed the ticket is Tansleigh Packaging's.

I also told Hollis not to mix it up with #8841, a separate ticket for the Door 2 double-booking on Tobias's dealer account. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used what they can already see.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 June 2026 as the Marrow Agrisupply ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. I also passed on Hollis's warning from that same message: the import file labels the doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be fixed before anyone reimports so it doesn't create duplicates. I don't know whether that was ever sorted out.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so I only used what they can already see.
